title: TxResBench tidy dataset format 2.0
description: One machine-readable definition of a tidy dataset: four canonical tables (patients, samples, values, features) plus values.meta.json, stored as Parquet with an explicit typed schema. Read by the dataset validator (Python) and by the package core (C++). A dataset or a user's data is valid when every rule with severity 'error' holds; 'warning' rules are reported only. See README.md in this folder for how to read this file.

string.note: UTF-8 text. patient_id, sample_id and feature are ALWAYS strings, never numbers, even when the ids look numeric.

float64.note: IEEE double. NaN is not allowed: a missing number is a Parquet null.

storage.meta_file_rule: valid JSON whose top level is an object (source files and sheets used, id mapping, unit per feature, rows dropped and why, caveats)

preview.note: Generated from the canonical tables by the build step, never edited, excluded from reproduction checks; patient-level, so it lives only in owner-only data folders.
preview.primary_feature: the feature with the most value rows among those not ending in __detected / __lod unless the builder names one; ties broken by feature name

files.patients: patients.csv (first n_patients rows of the patients table, all columns)
files.values: values.csv (their value rows for the first max_features features: primary first, then the rest by descending number of value rows, ties by name)
files.features: features.csv (ALL rows of the features table)
files.summary: SUMMARY.md (counts, columns and types, outcome and schedule summaries, verdict section)

column_patterns.description: Baseline covariate as in the source (cov_age, cov_sex, cov_stage, cov_ecog ...). One type per column: float64 when every non-null value is numeric, else string. Units go in features.csv under the feature named like the column.

extra_columns.note: Columns not listed below are allowed (dataset-specific documentation such as source_file) and ignored by the core. The writer stores them as float64 (all non-null values numeric) or string; the validator only requires that they are one of string / int64 / float64.

patients.description: One row per patient (per treatment line, if the id encodes the line).

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: Patient (or patient x treatment line) id; the key every other table refers to.

columns.name: n_blood_samples
columns.description: Number of blood draws of the patient.

columns.name: has_baseline
columns.description: 1 when the patient has a baseline draw.

columns.name: n_pre_outcome_draws
columns.description: Baseline plus on-treatment draws before the patient's own PFS time (dataset convention, see dataset.yaml).

columns.name: best_response_raw
columns.description: Best response exactly as the source writes it.

columns.name: best_response_recist
columns.description: Best overall response as a plain RECIST category when the source gives one; null otherwise (never '?').

columns.name: responder_binary
columns.description: 1 = responder, 0 = not.

columns.name: responder_rule
columns.description: How responder_binary was derived, e.g. 'CR+PR=1; SD+PD=0 (BOR)'.

columns.name: response_assessment_day
columns.description: Days from treatment start when the response label was assessed (per patient or the protocol's nominal day).

columns.name: pfs_time
columns.description: Progression-free survival time in time_unit from the same origin as day_from_start.

columns.name: pfs_event
columns.description: 1 = event, 0 = censored.

columns.name: os_time
columns.description: Overall survival time in time_unit.

columns.name: os_event
columns.description: 1 = event, 0 = censored.

columns.name: other_time
columns.description: Third endpoint time (named in dataset.yaml).

columns.name: other_event
columns.description: 1 = event, 0 = censored.

columns.name: time_unit
columns.description: Unit of every *_time column; one value for the whole file.

columns.name: time_origin
columns.description: Text: origin of the outcome times; must equal the origin of day_from_start or the difference is stated.

columns.name: treatment_arm
columns.description: Treatment arm or regimen.

columns.name: cancer_type
columns.description: Cancer type or disease.

columns.name: person_id
columns.description: Person id when patient_id encodes a treatment line (several rows per person).

columns.name: treatment_line
columns.description: Treatment line number when patient_id encodes the line.

columns.name: dcb
columns.description: Durable clinical benefit label as in the source.

columns.name: source_file
columns.description: Source file or sheet the row came from.

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: Patient the draw belongs to; a patients.patient_id.

columns.name: sample_id
columns.description: Draw id, unique in the dataset.

columns.name: timepoint_label
columns.description: Label of the draw in the source (C1D1, T2, month 6 ...).

columns.name: day_from_start
columns.description: Days from the start of the evaluated treatment (day 0 = first dose). Null only when day_source = 'unknown'.

columns.name: day_source
columns.description: file: a date or day column; paper: the paper states the day of the label; schedule: derived from the stated schedule; unknown: day not established (then day_from_start is null and the draw has no value rows).

columns.name: phase
columns.description: Position of the draw relative to the treatment and the outcome.

columns.name: modality
columns.description: Assay or modality.

columns.name: source_file
columns.description: Source file or sheet.

values.description: One row per sample x feature (long).

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: A patients.patient_id.

columns.name: sample_id
columns.description: A samples.sample_id.

columns.name: day_from_start
columns.description: Days from the start of the evaluated treatment; equals samples.day_from_start of the same sample. Never null: a row whose day cannot be established is left out.

columns.name: feature
columns.description: Marker name, a features.feature.

columns.name: value
columns.description: Value on the scale the source reports (no log, no scaling). Null only if the source gives no number. A non-detect with no number is 0 plus <feature>__detected = 0.

features.description: One row per marker documented. May also hold documentation rows for patient columns (cov_*), which are not values.feature entries.

columns.name: feature
columns.description: Marker name (or cov_* column name).

columns.name: unit
columns.description: Unit of the value.

columns.name: platform
columns.description: Assay or platform.

columns.name: description
columns.description: What the feature is and how non-detects are coded.

columns.name: n_samples_with_value
columns.description: Number of samples with a value.

rules.description: every column with required=true exists in its table
rules.message: required column missing

rules.description: every listed column and every column matching a column_pattern has its declared type; extra columns are string, int64 or float64
rules.message: column has the wrong type

rules.description: columns with nullable=false contain no nulls (ids, feature, values.day_from_start, samples.day_source and phase, patients.time_unit)
rules.message: null in a non-nullable column

rules.description: columns with an enum contain only its values (phase, day_source, time_unit, *_event / responder_binary / has_baseline in {0,1}, best_response_recist)
rules.message: value outside the allowed set

rules.description: columns with a minimum respect it (outcome times >= 0, counts >= 0)
rules.message: value below the allowed minimum

rules.description: unique_keys of every table: patients.patient_id; samples.sample_id; values (patient_id, sample_id, feature); features.feature
rules.message: duplicate key
values row whose patient is not in patients

rules.description: pfs_time and pfs_event are both null or both set; same for os. The third endpoint (other_*) is not paired: 007 carries other_event without other_time.
rules.message: time without event (or event without time)

rules.description: an outcome time of exactly 0 is reported; it can never be eligible after a landmark. Kept a warning because 001 has one patient with pfs_time = 0 in the source; R06 still rejects negative times.
rules.message: outcome time is 0
day_from_start outside [-180, 3650]

rules.origin: dataset-tidy.md (Format 2.0, preview generated from the canonical tables)
rules.description: preview/ files equal what the generator makes from the canonical tables (everything in SUMMARY.md before the '## Verdict' heading). Not part of in-memory validation.
rules.message: preview inconsistent with the canonical tables

content_hash.column_order: columns in the order of this file (including optional ones when present), then column_patterns and extra columns sorted by name
content_hash.row_order: rows sorted by all columns of the table's first unique key (strings compared by code point), ties broken by the serialised row

cell_normalisation.float64: JSON number from Python repr of the float (shortest round-trip); -0.0 becomes 0.0

content_hash.row_serialisation: JSON array of the cells, separators (',', ':'), ensure_ascii false; rows joined by newline; the header line is the JSON array of 'name:type' pairs
